summary: Nine days to FreightWorks Expo. Slot picker merged and the pricing page and one-pager are final. Coastal, a design partner, has had a login outage since this morning and its CEO is questioning readiness. Pinecrest demo is at 3pm. The booth ships Thursday. Harbor renews Oct 30.

items.text: Coastal users cannot log in since this morning (redirect loop after SSO, Coastal accounts only) and are back on spreadsheets. TW-144 is with Leila, due today.
Grace at Coastal says her CEO is asking whether Smart Slots is ready for real use. Jordan's call with Grace (TW-145) is due today.

Coastal is a Smart Slots design partner (15% of revenue, live in staging with twelve users). The outage puts its confidence and the design-partner launch target at risk; TW-121 (both partners live) is due Oct 30.
Valley's Smart Slots setup starts today and its first week of bookings is imported. Valley is the other design partner in TW-121.
Pinecrest sees the live demo at 3pm today. It is still unsigned as third design partner (TW-126, due Oct 30); signing would meet the launch goal.
Slot picker PR #241 merged after Sam's design review (TW-141 and TW-117 done). Screen 3 of the demo is no longer blocked by the build.
Demo flow (TW-119, due Oct 30) is at 2:10 in the dry run; Sam's earlier target was under two minutes. Maya's booth script (TW-120) is in progress, due Oct 30.
The booth ships Thursday, so anything printed must be final by Wednesday. Sam's one-pager is final in Figma, and print files (TW-150) are due Oct 28.
Pricing page is final (TW-125 done), with final numbers. Expo invites went to 40 accounts (TW-122 done).
Scoring API (TW-115, due Oct 28) passed a 5x load test. Nina's 10x load test (TW-143, due Oct 30) is scheduled for Wednesday. TW-138 (Coastal early-dock ranking, due Oct 28) is in progress.

New booth-readiness tickets: rate limits TW-146 (Arjun, Oct 30), demo environment TW-147 (Arjun, Oct 29), score caching TW-148 (Nina, Oct 30), tablet mode TW-149 (Leila, Oct 29). TW-135 empty/error states due Oct 29.
All Harbor QBR follow-ups are done: notes sent to Dana (TW-139), 4-week trend in weekly report (TW-140), sync alerts in its ops channel (TW-142). Harbor renews Oct 30.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had repeated duplicates. The root-cause fix has shipped, but renewal prep TW-113 is still todo, due Nov 13.
Arjun is on call this week (from Oct 26). Partner API docs are published (TW-127 done), and the October investor update was sent (TW-111).
